name: Brain knowledge parser TypeScript exemplar
decision: Use packages/harness/src/brainKnowledgeReadModel.ts as a local reference implementation recipe for unknown-first brain-knowledge parser boundaries. Future similar parser work may clone the approach: external catalog JSON enters as unknown, finite status/action fields are narrowed with explicit sets, missing evidence-boundary fields reject the record, and tests cover invalid enum values, missing proof boundaries, usefulness-feedback readback, and deterministic text search. The exemplar guides implementation shape but does not replace tests, evidence capture, or source-to-decision mapping.
sourceRefs: user-provided screenshots 2026-07-01: reference implementation, clone workflow, recipe hashing, and code-as-up-to-date-documentation practitioner notes
consumers: future brain knowledge catalog JSON changes
falsifier: A future parser-boundary repair claims this exemplar while trusting external JSON directly, accepting missing proof-boundary fields, omitting invalid-enum tests, skipping deterministic search/readback proof, or treating the exemplar as a runtime clone system.
doesNotProve: This exemplar does not prove broad TypeScript quality, runtime clone automation, semantic ranking quality, product readiness, or that every parser should copy the exact helper names and file structure.
